notes.title: Miss Seiko Bug fixes!
notes.content:
Hello players! 
We recently fixed a lot of major bugs during the Seiko extra chapter of Witch College! Now you can enjoy her full story! 

If you haven't heard, we released for free extra chapters with Hana and Miss Seiko! What crazy adventures await you with them at the Himawari Art College? Find out in this FREE update!

notes.title: 2 extra chapters!
notes.content: Hello! New BIG update for Witch College! We prepared two whole new chapters to the story and are completely FREE! We originally intended these to be DLC, but decided to include them with the base game!
